n01.roman: GTA V ke Los Santos ki gaadiyan aur saamaan banane mein Bengaluru ki ek team ka haath tha.

n02.roman: Naam tha Technicolor Games. Chehre ka animation aur motion capture ki safaai bhi inhone ki.

n03.roman: Ab twist! 2016 ke aaspaas Rockstar ne Bengaluru mein apna studio khola: Rockstar India!

n04.roman: Ye studio Red Dead Redemption 2 ki development team ka hissa bana.

n05.roman: May 2019 mein ismein mila Dhruva Interactive, Bharat ka sabse purana game developer. Team: kareeb 800 log!

n06.roman: Aaj iski ek job post kehti hai: yahan ki team motion capture se kirdaron ki harkatein banati hai, saare Rockstar games ke liye.
